name: CData Sync
description_en:
CData Sync replicates data from configured sources into databases, warehouses and other supported destinations. Its execution model is a job containing source and destination connections plus table-level tasks. After an initial load, supported sources can use incremental checks or change-data capture rather than repeat the entire source read.

Sync can run in customer infrastructure, cloud infrastructure or the vendor’s Sync Cloud offering. Those deployment choices and commercial entitlements are separate. This profile focuses on Sync, not the wider CData catalog of drivers, API products or other integration services.
description_zh:
CData Sync 将配置好的源数据复制到数据库、仓库及其他受支持目标。执行模型是包含源和目标连接、以及表级 task 的 job。初次加载后，支持的源可采用增量检查或变更数据捕获，避免每次读取全部源数据。

Sync 可运行在客户基础设施、云基础设施或厂商 Sync Cloud 中，部署位置与商业权限分别决定。本文聚焦 Sync，不把 CData 更广的驱动、API 产品及其他集成服务混入同一档案。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure source/destination connections and tasks within a scheduled job.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在计划 job 中配置源、目标连接与任务。

core_features.explanation_en: Use a supported increasing check column or log-based CDC after initial loading.
core_features.explanation_zh: 初次加载后，使用受支持递增检查列或基于日志的 CDC。

core_features.explanation_en: Inspect per-run results and optionally retry failed tasks once.
core_features.explanation_zh: 检查逐次结果，并可选对失败任务重试一次。

en: Replicate a customer table into a test warehouse with an explicit incremental check.
Inspect failed table tasks and reconcile destination state after a rerun.
zh: 用明确增量检查将客户表复制到测试仓库。
检查失败表任务，并在重跑后对照目标状态。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Choose installed or managed deployment and obtain the matching license.
steps.zh: 选择安装或托管部署，取得对应许可。

steps.en: Configure a source and destination, then one table task in a job.
steps.zh: 配置源和目标，再在 job 中加入一个表任务。

steps.en: Verify initial/incremental results, schema handling and failed-task history.
steps.zh: 核对初次与增量结果、schema 处理及失败任务历史。

items.en: Standard pricing has a processed-row band; unlimited rows require a separately specified configuration.
items.zh: Standard 有处理行档位，无限行需另外明确配置。

items.en: One automatic retry does not replace a permanent-error repair process.
items.zh: 一次自动重试不能代替永久错误修复。

pricing.billing_basis: Standard annual license with connections and monthly processed-row band; custom and cloud purchase paths differ.

sections.title_en: A job groups a specific replication workload
sections.title_zh: Job 组织具体复制负载
sections.en: The getting-started guide defines connections for source and destination and tasks for table data flows. Job settings add scheduling, incremental behavior, notifications and optional events. For a proposed evaluation, start with a single source customer table and a test destination schema; avoid mixing several unrelated tables before understanding one result. Record the source identifier and expected update rule. A valid connection test only checks an access path, not that the selected table task has the desired business semantics.
sections.zh: 入门指南区分源与目标连接，以及控制表数据流的 task。Job 设置再加入调度、增量行为、通知及可选事件。建议先用一张源客户表和测试目标 schema，理解一项结果后再组合多张无关表。应记录源标识与预期更新规则。连接测试通过只能说明一条访问路径可用，不能证明所选表任务符合业务语义。

sections.title_en: Check-column and CDC strategies require different source setup
sections.title_zh: 检查列与 CDC 需要不同的源配置
sections.en: An incremental check column must increase when a record is inserted or updated; a timestamp or numeric revision can serve that purpose when correctly maintained. CDC instead consumes supported source logs and remembers log position. For an illustrative customer record, change its name and check value, then confirm the destination update. Separately test an update where the check value does not change, and a delete if the chosen strategy supports it. The presence of “incremental” in a feature list does not establish equivalent deletion handling for every source.
sections.zh: 增量检查列需在记录插入或更新时递增，正确维护的时间戳或数字版本可承担此职责。CDC 则消费受支持的源日志并保存日志位置。以客户记录为例，可修改姓名及检查值，再核对目标更新；还应单独测试检查值不变的更新，以及所选策略支持时的删除。功能表出现“增量”，不代表每种源都以相同方式处理删除。

sections.title_en: Metadata caching and schema evolution are operational choices
sections.title_zh: 元数据缓存与结构演变是运营选择
sections.en: The features guide describes metadata caching per supported connector, with refresh intervals. Cached metadata may need explicit refresh after a structural change. A pipeline owner should evaluate adding a column, changing a type and modifying a destination mapping on a test schema before relying on automatic behavior. Keep the difference between schema discovery and successful data loading visible in acceptance. No schema migration was executed here, and the platform feature description is not a guarantee for every connector/database combination.
sections.zh: 功能指南描述受支持连接器的元数据缓存及刷新间隔，结构变化后可能需要明确刷新。流程负责人应在测试 schema 中评估新增列、类型变化及目标映射修改，再依赖自动行为。验收中应区分成功发现 schema 与成功加载数据。本文未执行结构迁移，平台功能描述也不能保证所有连接器和数据库组合行为相同。

sections.title_en: Retry is limited and job success needs a record check
sections.title_zh: 重试有范围，任务成功还需核对记录
sections.en: Automatic Job Retry reruns only failed tasks and makes one retry attempt, excluding cancelled jobs. Job History shows status, affected records and runtime. Source, destination and replication-engine logs help locate a failure. A partial run may already have committed work, so a retry policy should be checked alongside destination identifiers and data consistency rather than treated as an all-or-nothing transaction. Our suggested acceptance compares one normal load, an interrupted load and a subsequent resumed result; none was performed here.
sections.zh: Automatic Job Retry 只重新运行失败 task，尝试一次，取消的 job 不在范围内。Job History 提供状态、影响记录及运行时间；源、目标和复制引擎日志有助定位问题。部分运行可能已经提交工作，因此应结合目标标识及数据一致性核对重试，不能把整个 job 当全有或全无事务。建议比较正常加载、中断加载及之后恢复结果，本文未实际执行。

sections.title_en: Detailed transfer logs can include the data itself
sections.title_zh: 详细传输日志可能包含业务数据
sections.en: Info is the documented default logging level. Transfer and Verbose include increasingly detailed communication, and the guide warns that raw transferred data can be exposed even when connection passwords are masked. Choose a temporary diagnostic level appropriate for the incident, restrict access and review a log before sharing it. Logs are evidence for investigating the job, not proof that the analytical model is complete or the business application accepted every intended change.
sections.zh: 文档默认日志级别为 Info；Transfer、Verbose 包含更多通信细节，指南警告，即使连接密码被掩码，原始传输数据仍可能暴露。排障时应选择适当临时级别、限制访问，并在分享前检查日志。日志可用于调查 job，但不能证明分析模型完整或业务应用接受了每项预期变化。

sections.title_en: Read row bands alongside connection pricing
sections.title_zh: 连接价格也要配合行数档位理解
sections.en: The pricing table lists Standard at $7,999/year, up to five standard connections and 100 million processed rows/month. Unlimited rows, premium connectors, CDC, transformations and some access/API controls are listed in custom configurations. This is more specific than the homepage’s broad connection-based/unlimited-movement language, so the Standard row band must remain visible. Cloud-marketplace hourly options and BYOL are distinct purchase paths, not a direct monthly equivalent. Confirm how processed rows, repeat loads, destinations and connectors count in the quote; no universal overage rate was established.
sections.zh: 定价表列出 Standard 每年 $7,999，最多五个标准连接、每月一亿处理行；无限行、高级连接器、CDC、转换及部分访问／API 控制列入定制配置。这比首页概括的连接计价及无限移动更具体，因此不能隐去 Standard 行数档位。云市场按小时方案与 BYOL 是不同购买路径，不能直接当作统一月费。应在报价中确认处理行、重复加载、目标和连接器如何计数，本次未确认统一超额费率。

sections.title_en: Installed software and managed Cloud use different agreements
sections.title_zh: 安装软件与托管 Cloud 适用不同协议
sections.en: The official EULA describes Sync Self-Hosted as proprietary licensed software and points Sync Cloud to a separate service agreement. It states that evaluation licenses must not be used in production and that quote-specific terms and limitations matter. Installing on your own server is therefore not a free production or source-redistribution entitlement. Establish the exact deployment, license term and customer-facing use case before purchasing. This profile records the documented boundary, not approval of a particular contract interpretation.
sections.zh: 官方 EULA 将 Sync Self-Hosted 描述为专有许可软件，Sync Cloud 另适用服务协议；评估许可不得用于生产，具体报价条款及限制也很重要。因此安装到自己的服务器，不等于获得免费生产或源码分发权限。购买前应明确部署、许可期限及面向客户的用途。本文记录文档边界，不替具体合同解释作批准。

sections.title_en: Select Sync for a maintained replication pipeline
sections.title_zh: 选择 Sync 时也要安排复制维护
sections.en: CData Sync merits evaluation for teams replicating SaaS or database data into a controlled destination with explicit incremental behavior. It is a weaker fit if an unverified generic connector label is the only basis for a required endpoint, CDC mode or reverse-ETL operation. Assign someone to check source quotas, job history, schema changes and destination records. No throughput, cluster failover, backup restoration, interface localization or cost advantage was measured for this profile.
sections.zh: 当团队希望把 SaaS 或数据库数据复制到可控目标，并明确增量行为时，CData Sync 值得评估。若所需端点、CDC 模式或反向 ETL 操作仅有未经核对的通用连接器标签支撑，则适用性较弱。应安排人员检查源额度、运行历史、结构变化与目标记录。本文未测吞吐、集群故障转移、备份恢复、界面本地化或费用优势。
